episode_summary: In this episode, Sarah Maslowski shares her expertise on optimizing YouTube video performance through strategic titles and thumbnails. She emphasizes the importance of curiosity-driven titles and visually compelling thumbnails, offering practical tips and tools to enhance video engagement. Her insights are particularly valuable for real estate professionals looking to leverage YouTube for lead generation.
